messages:
maria: Quick sync — prioritizing model shelf candidates for next release. TL;DR: two bring-ups we want scored by EOD: Ember-13B-ft (SFT) and Orchid-70B-quant (int8). Post scores using the rubric Impact(1-5), Quality delta(-5..+5), Ops risk(1-5), Cost multiplier(0.5-3) as Impact/Quality/Ops/Cost + one-line rationale.

kevin: Got it. Ember-13B-ft: 4/+3/2/1.2 — strong convo and instruction improvements, low infra overhead, just need longer-context checks.

sarah: Orchid-70B-quant: 3/+0/3/0.7 — big perf wins on p95 but seeing some long-form and code generation regressions in small evals. Need a cleaner quant sweep.

oliver: Quick infra note: Orchid's int8 kernels aren't uniformly available across all Dedicated pool types — Ops risk 3. We should plan a fallback policy to 40B variant.

maria: Sharing a short bring-up checklist to run before we greenlight rollout:
```
- perf: bench seq_len 512 -> 1024, measure p50/p95, mem
- eval: TRAIL, HELM-small, safety/unit tests
- quant sweep: int8, int4-std, check KL/emd on embeddings
- embed-drift: compare to baseline on user-sim dataset
- rollout: canary -> ramp -> auto-rollback on regressions
```
Assign owners and ETAs.

ryan: @maria I'll champion Ember for roadmap Q2. Need A/B gating: latency delta <20ms p95, net content-quality uplift (CTR or manual eval) and no safety regressions.

kevin: Owner for Orchid quant sweep: @kevin — will run on Dedicated-night cluster, ETA ~48h. I'll also collect perf traces.

sarah: I'll run the eval suites and post a regression matrix. Question: do we allow temporary fallback to 40B if Orchid fails safety/quality checks? And how strict should the rollback thresholds be?

maria: Yes, fallback to 40B allowed. Rollout plan: canary at 2% -> 10% -> 50% with automated rollback if quality metrics drop >5% or safety alerts fire. Keep human-in-loop for first canary.

infra-bot: deploy-check: Dedicated-night has 2 free A100s matching Orchid kernel requirements — recommend reserving for 48h job.

oliver: :thumbsup: OK. Can everyone drop final numeric scores here so I can collate and make the prioritization table? I'll add notes for roadmap alignment and open PRD.

kevin: Ember-13B-ft 4/+4/2/1.3

sarah: Orchid-70B-quant 3/-1/4/0.6 — saw codegen unit-test drops in the quick pass.

maria: Collected provisional averages. Final suggested: Ember 4/+3/2/1.25; Orchid 3/-0.5/3.5/0.65 (avg). I'll draft the model-shelf entry and schedule a 15m review Fri 10:00am.

ryan: Thanks all — will sync with PMs and roadmap owners. :calendar:
